title: Dashboards
summary: Composable dashboards, personal or shared, made of gadgets: filter results list, counter, bar or pie chart by field, sprint burndown, workload mini-heatmap and "my tickets". Every gadget is fed by the query language or an existing report, so permissions and RLS always apply. Dashboards update in real time and their charts have an accessible table alternative.

stories.title: Create and arrange a personal dashboard
stories.i_want: to create dashboards and add, move, resize and remove gadgets
stories.so_that: I see the information I need at a glance
acceptance: Given I am signed in, When I create a dashboard with a name, Then it is saved as personal and appears in my dashboard selector
Given a dashboard I own, When I add a gadget from the catalog, Then it appears in the grid and is persisted
Given a dashboard I own, When I move or resize gadgets with the mouse or the keyboard, Then the layout is saved
Given a dashboard changed by me in another tab, When I save a stale version, Then I am warned of the conflict instead of overwriting it
Given a dashboard I do not own and that is not shared with me, When I request it, Then it is not found

tech.title: Create dashboard and gadget tables with RLS
tech.description: Add `dashboard` (tenant_id, owner account, translatable-free name, version) and `gadget` (dashboard_id, type, position x/y, width/height, JSONB settings such as query and field) tables with an SQLx migration, RLS and tenant-first indexes.
done_when: Migration applies; integration test verifies RLS isolation
Deleting a dashboard cascades to its gadgets (integration test)

tech.title: Expose dashboard and gadget CRUD endpoints
tech.description: Add `/api/v1/dashboards` endpoints: create, list mine and shared with me, get, update layout with If-Match, delete, and gadget add/update/remove. Gadget settings are validated per gadget type in `crates/domain` (allowed types, required settings, valid query).
done_when: Unit tests cover gadget settings validation per type
Integration tests cover CRUD, stale ETag 412, ownership checks and cross-tenant isolation
Angular client regenerated

tech.title: Build the dashboard page with a gadget grid
tech.description: In `projects/app`, build the dashboard page: dashboard `mat-select` selector, Add gadget button opening a catalog `MatDialog`, and a responsive grid using CDK drag and drop, with keyboard move/resize actions in each gadget's `mat-menu`. Tokens and Transloco only.
done_when: Component unit tests cover add, move, resize, remove and conflict display
Keyboard-only layout editing works; axe check passes

stories.title: Add query-based gadgets: list, counter and chart
stories.i_want: to add a filter results list, a counter and a bar or pie chart by field fed by a query
stories.so_that: I can track any set of tickets the way I want
acceptance: Given a saved filter or a query, When I add a list gadget with chosen columns, Then it shows the matching tickets I am allowed to see, paginated
Given a query, When I add a counter gadget, Then it shows the number of matching tickets and opens the search when clicked
Given a query and a field such as status, When I add a bar or pie chart gadget, Then it shows the count per value with translated labels
Given a chart gadget, When a screen reader user reaches it, Then an equivalent data table is available
Given an invalid query, When I save the gadget, Then the query error is shown and the gadget is not saved

tech.title: Add a group-by count endpoint on the query language
tech.description: Extend search with an aggregation endpoint (`POST /api/v1/search/aggregate` with query and group-by field) compiled to parameterized SQL by the query compiler, returning counts per stable value with labels in the Accept-Language language. Permissions and RLS apply.
done_when: Unit tests in crates/domain cover group-by compilation for system and custom fields
Integration tests cover counts, permission filtering, confidential projects and cross-tenant isolation

tech.title: Build list, counter and chart gadget components
tech.description: Build three gadget components: list (`mat-table` with displayed columns and pagination), counter (large number with link to search), and bar/pie chart drawn in SVG using --mat-sys-* and --app-* tokens, each with a toggleable accessible table view. Each has a settings dialog with the query editor from L06.
done_when: Component unit tests cover settings, rendering, empty and error states
Chart colors come only from tokens; axe check passes on the table alternative

tech.title: Refresh gadgets on real-time ticket events
tech.description: Subscribe dashboards to the real-time stream from L05 and refresh the affected gadgets with a debounce when ticket events arrive, without reloading the page.
done_when: Unit tests cover debounced refresh on events
Integration test of the SSE subscription against a test server

stories.title: Add agile and workload gadgets
stories.i_want: to add a sprint burndown, a workload mini-heatmap and a "my tickets" gadget
stories.so_that: my team's dashboard covers delivery and load in one place
acceptance: Given a Scrum board with an active sprint, When I add a burndown gadget for that board, Then it shows the sprint burndown in points or hours as configured on the board
Given a team, When I add a workload mini-heatmap gadget over N weeks, Then it shows the occupation rate per resource and week with overloads highlighted, and links to the full heatmap
Given the "my tickets" gadget, When I view it, Then it lists unresolved tickets assigned to me (assignee = currentUser())
Given a confidential project in the team's load, When the mini-heatmap is shown, Then its time appears as Busy (confidential) without detail
Given each gadget, When rendered, Then an equivalent accessible table is available

tech.title: Validate agile and workload gadget settings and data access
tech.description: Register burndown, mini-heatmap and my-tickets gadget types with their settings (board id, team id, number of weeks) and validate them. Data comes from the existing L08/L09 report endpoints; add any missing weekly aggregate read needed by the mini-heatmap.
done_when: Unit tests cover settings validation
Integration tests cover data access permissions, confidential masking and cross-tenant isolation

tech.title: Build burndown, mini-heatmap and my-tickets gadgets
tech.description: Reuse the burndown chart from L09 and the heatmap color scale (--app-heatmap-* tokens) from L08 in compact gadget components, plus a my-tickets list with `ui-status-chip`. Each provides an accessible table view and a link to the full screen.
done_when: Component unit tests cover rendering, empty state (no active sprint, empty team) and links
axe check passes

stories.title: Share a dashboard with users, groups or a team
stories.i_want: to share a dashboard read-only or editable
stories.so_that: my team works from the same view
acceptance: Given a dashboard I own, When I share it with a user or a group as viewer, Then they see it in their selector and cannot edit it
Given I share it as editor, When an editor changes the layout, Then the change is saved for everyone
Given a shared dashboard, When a viewer sees a gadget, Then its data is filtered by the viewer's own permissions
Given I revoke a share, When the former viewer reloads, Then the dashboard is no longer available

tech.title: Store dashboard shares and enforce them in the API
tech.description: Add a `dashboard_share` table (dashboard, account or group, role viewer/editor) with RLS, and share/revoke endpoints. Dashboard reads and writes check ownership or share role; gadget data is always computed with the caller's permissions.
done_when: Integration tests cover viewer read-only, editor write, revocation, group membership and per-viewer data filtering
Unit tests cover the access decision

tech.title: Build the share dashboard dialog
tech.description: Add a Share `MatDialog` with a user/group autocomplete, role `mat-select` and current shares list with revoke actions; show the shared-with subtitle on the dashboard header.
done_when: Component unit tests cover add, change role and revoke
axe check passes

tech.title: Add Playwright test for building and sharing a dashboard
tech.description: End-to-end test: create a dashboard, add a counter and a chart gadget, share it read-only with another user, and verify that user sees it without edit controls and with data filtered to their permissions.
done_when: Playwright test passes in CI through `just`, including an axe scan
